threshold_selection.selection_rule: From validation target and near-confusable examples, maximize target correct pass rate subject to combined lesson false-pass below 0.10; tie-break lower false-pass then higher threshold.

blockers: Diagnostic uses a 95-label checkpoint filtered to lesson target outputs; it is not final 75-100-label evidence.
Prediction sidecar was generated in smoke/diagnostic mode to avoid replacing final validation evidence.
No first-party browser-domain hard negatives are included beyond the current external negative challenge manifest.
